spans.text: Several days later. In the morgue of a secret URNC facility.
In the absolute silence, only the faint, low hum of the refrigeration system can be heard.
William's body lies still on a cold metal autopsy table, covered by a thin white sheet. It has undergone only minimal cleaning.
On his forehead, the fatal bullet wound declares without mercy the unmistakable end of his life.
It is all written in stone.
And yet, within this silence ruled by death, something begins to awaken.
Not a heartbeat. Not a breath.
A thread-like strand of pitch-black fluid slowly seeps out.
It does not clot like blood. Instead, it moves like a living organism, tentatively writhing across the cold skin.
At first, there is only one strand. Then a second. A third...
More and more of the black substance oozes from their wounds, gathering into a viscous pool of darkness—one that seems to swallow all light.
It has no fixed shape. At times it extends pseudopod-like tendrils; at others, it contracts into a smooth, oil-like mass.
This "living" darkness begins to creep upward along William's body.
It makes no sound, yet it carries an undeniable sense of purpose.

It flows across his pallid chest, coils around his bloodless neck. Wherever it passes, faint, web-like black veins emerge beneath the skin, as though constructing an entirely new network of nerves and vessels.
At last, it reaches the fatal bullet wound.
The darkness lingers at the edge for a moment... Then, without hesitation, it pours inside, filling the hollow left by the bullet.
The morgue is still quiet as a tomb.
But beneath the white sheet, on the body that should have remained forever cold—
Twitches.
